quaternion_multiply: multiply two quaternions using the Hamilton product convention with w,x,y,z ordering
quaternion_y_rotation: create a quaternion representing rotation about the Y-axis by a given angle gamma
quaternion_nlerp: perform normalized linear interpolation between two quaternions using an interpolation parameter t
quaternion_edge_to_y_stable: compute a singularity-free quaternion that rotates an edge vector to the positive Y-axis
smooth_step_cinf: compute a C-infinity smooth step function for blending between two quaternion charts
